build_steps.description: Install git, curl, python3.11-venv via apt-get
Execute repo_setup.sh to clone and materialize /workspace from Azure SDK for Python repo
Execute setup_runtime.sh to create venv at /opt/benchmark/venv and install all Python dependencies

verification_assets.mount_strategy: eval.sh and test.patch are mounted at runtime from /artifacts/evaluation/, not baked into image

notes: The Dockerfile uses a two-stage setup: repo_setup.sh materializes the workspace from git, then setup_runtime.sh creates the Python venv and installs dependencies. Verifier assets (eval.sh, test.patch) are runtime-mounted, not baked into the image.
